mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_param (id, api_id, param_name, param_type, data_type, default_value, description, validate_rule) VALUES (#{id}, #{apiId}, #{paramName}, #{paramType}, #{dataType}, #{defaultValue}, #{description}, #{validateRule})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_param SET api_id = #{apiId}, param_name = #{paramName}, param_type = #{paramType}, data_type = #{dataType}, default_value = #{defaultValue}, description = #{description}, validate_rule = #{validateRule} WHERE id = #{id}
